description: Main window only. Deliberately does NOT grant opener:default: its http(s)://* scope would let the webview open any URL directly and bypass the open_external allowlist, and reveal-item-in-dir has no scope check at all. open_external calls the opener from Rust, which does not go through this ACL. autostart:default is absent for the same reason and needs no replacement: launch at login is reached through set_launch_at_login in commands.rs, which calls the plugin from Rust, so the plugin's own enable/disable/is_enabled commands are never invoked from the webview and granting them would only add a second, unguarded way in.
